verdict.what: an open-sided wooden pavilion on a stone plinth, with a stepped hip roof and lanterns
verdict.style: East Asian-inspired pavilion, or a market shelter / pagoda-style hall
verdict.summary: A clear pavilion massing on a proper stone plinth with well-placed lanterns and a railed porch, but the stair-stepped roof reads as a heavy lid with blocky edges, and the dark wood on dark wood makes the open walls muddy and hard to read from the street.
